scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; finite numerical cross-checks are not proof. No independent validation or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Independent complete refresh samples drawn from the exact OU invariant Gaussian law, constant positive Poisson rate, stationary initialization, strictly positive confinement and noise required.
Fourth-cumulant optimum is in lag t, not a finite-sample detectability optimum.
General distributed-reset renewal formalism and Gaussian information inequalities preexist; priority beyond examined papers remains uncertain.
title: Gaussian-marginal camouflage and an exact fourth-order lag peak under equilibrium Poisson refreshing
